_comment: Analysis > Remove Photo-bleaching (+ebfret/+ui/+dialog/remove_bleaching.m): the Threshold popup, five checkbox/edit rows (edit enabled by its checkbox, all disabled in Auto) and Ok/Cancel.

sections.label: Threshold
sections.description: Manual: crop where a smoothed channel first falls below its threshold. Auto: detect the bleaching step in donor and acceptor.

sections.label: Donor
sections.description: Crop where the donor intensity falls below the value.
Donor intensity threshold in counts per frame.

sections.label: Acceptor
sections.description: Crop where the acceptor intensity falls below the value.
Acceptor intensity threshold in counts per frame.

sections.label: Don + Acc
sections.description: Crop where donor plus acceptor falls below the value.
Threshold on donor plus acceptor intensity in counts per frame.

sections.label: FRET
sections.description: Crop where the FRET signal falls below the value.

sections.label: Padding
sections.description: Frames removed before the detected point.
Number of frames removed before the detected point.
